source.rationale: The zero-hit close. An empty (but successful) probe is a MEASURED zero, not a failure, so the node is entitled to say so - and it says it once, in a sentence, instead of leaving the customer to read three '- no delivery' suffixes and infer it. Distinguishing this from hand-annotate-probe-failed-renders-bare is the entire reason D2 exists: same rendered shape upstream, opposite entitlement to make a claim. customer_probe_hits is 0 here and null there.
